data.name: Labeebat
data.gender_notes: Labeebat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is kind-hearted, loving, and gentle to others. The name Labeebat carries the meaning “Tender-hearted, loving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Labeebat usually hope their child will grow to embody tender-hearted, loving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to the deep emotional connection between a mother and her child, symbolizing love, care, and nurturing
data.etymology: Labeebat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tender-hearted, loving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Labeebat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: لبيبات
in_arabic.meaning: لبيبات تعني الذكية و العاقلة و الحكيمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: لبيبات هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل لَبَّبَ، والذي يعني التلبين و الإجابة. وصفات حاملة هذا الاسم هي الذكية، العاقلة، الحكيمة، و التي تتصف بالفهم و الإدراك السريع. كما أن لها معنى آخر وهو الفتاة التي تلبس قلبها على ما يؤلمها.

in_urdu.name: لبيبات
in_urdu.long_meaning: لبيبات ایک عربی ಮೂಲ کا اسم مؤنث ہے، جو لَبَّبَ فعل سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے ذہین، عقلمند، حكيم اور سمجھدار۔ اس نام کی خاتون کو ذہانت، عقل، حکمت، اور فہم و ادراک کی خصوصیات سے نوازا گیا ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان خواتین کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے دل کی باتوں کو سمجھنے اور ان کے مطابق زندگی گزارنے کی صلاحیت رکھتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: लेबीबत
in_hindi.long_meaning: लेबीबत एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो लब्बब فعل से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है बुद्धिमान, समझदार और ज्ञानवान। इस नाम की महिला को बुद्धिमत्ता, समझदारी और ज्ञान की विशेषताओं से सजाया गया है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन महिलाओं के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपनी बुद्धिमत्ता और समझदारी के कारण प्रसिद्ध होती हैं।

in_pashto.name: لبيبات
in_pashto.long_meaning: لبيبات د عربي اصلي ښځينه نوم دی، چې د لَبَّبَ فعل څخه اخيستل شوی دی. دا نوم د هوښيار، عقلمند او پوه ښځې لپاره کارول کيږي. په پښتنو دود کې، دا نوم د هغو ښځو لپاره استعمال کيږي چې د پوهې او عقلمندۍ په برخه کې لوړه شوې.

in_english.name: Labeebat
in_english.long_meaning: Labeebat is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb labbaba, meaning to make sense or to understand. It signifies intelligence, wisdom, and understanding. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with women who possess mental clarity, wise decision-making, and spiritual insight. The name Labeebat has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the importance of intellect and wisdom in a person's character.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Labeebat" holds a significant cultural impact on those who bear it, as it is a reminder to be compassionate and caring towards others. This quality is highly valued in Islamic culture, as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) emphasized the importance of treating others with kindness and respect.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Labeebat" serves as a reminder of the importance of maintaining a good heart, one that is full of love and compassion towards all of God's creations. It is a reflection of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) guidance to spread kindness and generosity, as mentioned in a hadith, "The strong is not the one who overpowers the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger." Thus, "Labeebat" signifies not only a disposition towards kindness and gentleness, but also a striving to control one's anger and negative emotions, and instead, respond with love and compassion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Tender-hearted, loving" symbolizes One who is kind-hearted, loving, and gentle to others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Labeebat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of tender-hearted, loving.
